newsitem.title: USA: Allis-Chalmers seeks to end pension plan.
newsitem.headline: Allis-Chalmers seeks to end pension plan.

text.p: Allis-Chalmers Corp said Friday it has filed with the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp to initiate termination of the its consolidated pension plan.
The company said it has been in discussion with the PBGC about its pension liability, which is well in excess Allis-Chalmers' current net worth.

Although it is not possible to predict the outcome of such discussions, the company's options include seeking protection from its creditors by commencing voluntary bankruptcy proceedings under federal bankruptcy laws, the company said.
The plan is significantly underfunded and it is anticipated that the PBGC will assume the responsibilities of the plan, Allis-Chalmers said.
The company has failed to make required quarterly contributions starting in April 1996, resulting previously in the filing of a lien by the PBGC against the company, Allis-Chalmers said.
